provenance: Independently authored complete 39-scene Canvas product film with 3D document-card orbit/flip, pastel brand/logo/chips, dedicated editable upload/narration/player UI, eight labeled illustration cuts, 3D mosaic, five feature cards, stats and final cursor click/confetti. 21 isolated static illustration crops with full attribution; no source UI/video/frame sequence loaded. Original soundtrack comparison only.
editable: project.json chronology/palette/marks;composition.js all operations, geometry, camera, text and UI
differences: Geist/Kalam/JetBrains font outlines and tracking are close substitutes; exact original typography is not recovered.
Opening card orbital geometry, perspective, flips, front/back occlusion and video thumbnail assignments are independently modeled and differ.
Eight original illustrations are isolated static crops with all source style badges excluded; source art zoom timing and obscured lower-left artwork behind the badge differ.
Four small thumbnail illustrations are isolated and rectified; montage repeats 13 available artworks rather than reproducing every unique original illustration.
Editor typing/cursor/progress/highlight/player captions/waveform and panel perspective are authored; precise pacing, easing and individual bar amplitudes differ.

Player hand-drawn art is represented by isolated static illustration with authored timed cloud/label masks, not the original stroke-by-stroke artwork animation; masking edges and reveal timings differ.
Pastel glow, grid/star density, mosaic camera, diagonal wipes, CTA confetti and color bloom differ from source.
Numerical and offer text reproduce what is visible in the reference film, and are not presented as verified current product facts.
Original reference soundtrack is comparison-only, not independently authored.
